summary: Too steep (13.7%) with houses 12 m away on a junction kerb.

best_section.where: Waverley Road north kerb east of the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12 m, 14 m and 15 m along the section; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, but the grade is too steep to sleep on.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a junction at the start.
drivers.convention: Other cars park along this kerb; no signs.

sun_shade: Trees at the junction end shade it; sun from the south.
